component.name: ibm-watson-language
component.title: IBM Watson Language
component.description: Analyze text and web pages with IBM Watson Natural Language Understanding.
component.label: ai,cloud

serviceUrl.label: common
serviceUrl.description: The URL of the Natural Language Understanding service instance, as given in its service credentials. If not set, the SDK uses https://api.us-south.natural-language-understanding.watson.cloud.ibm.com (Dallas).

analyzeCategories.label: producer
analyzeCategories.description: Whether to request the categories of the content in a hierarchical taxonomy, by default the top three. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeCategories header replaces this option.

analyzeConcepts.label: producer
analyzeConcepts.description: Whether to request the high-level concepts of the content, which can include concepts that the text does not name. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeConcepts header replaces this option.

analyzeEmotion.label: producer
analyzeEmotion.description: Whether to request the emotions of the whole document: a score from 0 to 1 for anger, disgust, fear, joy and sadness. The service supports it for English only. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeEmotion header replaces this option.

analyzeEntities.label: producer
analyzeEntities.description: Whether to request the entities, such as people, cities and organizations, that the content mentions. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeEntities header replaces this option.

analyzeKeywords.label: producer
analyzeKeywords.description: Whether to request the important keywords of the content. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeKeywords header replaces this option.

analyzeSentiment.label: producer
analyzeSentiment.description: Whether to request the sentiment of the whole document. The producer then sets the CamelIBMWatsonLanguageSentimentScore and CamelIBMWatsonLanguageSentimentLabel headers. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeSentiment header replaces this option.

configuration.description: The configuration shared by the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its endpoint options replace single values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: analyzeText analyzes the given text, and analyzeUrl the web page at the given URL, which the service retrieves. The CamelIBMWatsonLanguageOperation header replaces this option. The producer fails if neither is set.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The IBM Cloud API key of the Natural Language Understanding service instance. The IBM Cloud IAM authenticator of the SDK exchanges it for an access token. The endpoint fails to start if it is not set.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageOperation.description: The operation to perform, analyzeText or analyzeUrl. It replaces the operation option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageText.description: The text to analyze for analyzeText. If not set, the producer analyzes the message body.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageUrl.description: The URL of the web page to analyze for analyzeUrl, which the service retrieves. If not set, the producer reads the URL from the message body.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeSentiment.description: Whether to request the sentiment of the document. It replaces the analyzeSentiment option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeEmotion.description: Whether to request the emotions of the document. It replaces the analyzeEmotion option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeEntities.description: Whether to request the entities of the content. It replaces the analyzeEntities option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeKeywords.description: Whether to request the keywords of the content. It replaces the analyzeKeywords option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeConcepts.description: Whether to request the concepts of the content. It replaces the analyzeConcepts option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageAnalyzeCategories.description: Whether to request the categories of the content. It replaces the analyzeCategories option.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageLanguage.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the language that the service detected and used for the analysis, for example en. The producer sets it after each analysis.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageSentimentScore.description: The sentiment score of the whole document, from -1 (negative) to 1 (positive). The producer sets it when sentiment is requested.

CamelIBMWatsonLanguageSentimentLabel.description: The sentiment label of the whole document: positive, neutral or negative. The producer sets it when sentiment is requested.

producerIn.description: The text to analyze for analyzeText, or the URL of the page for analyzeUrl, read as text, unless the CamelIBMWatsonLanguageText or CamelIBMWatsonLanguageUrl header gives it. Without the header, no body or a blank one fails, and a Map or a POJO is analyzed as its toString(): marshal it first

producerOut.description: The results of the features enabled (sentiment, entities, keywords and so on), with the sentiment score and label and the language in headers too. Converted to text, it is the JSON of the results

label.description: A name of your choice for the endpoint. The component does not use it.
